cases.question: 2026 年第二季度的总实付金额、有效订单量、平均客单价
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2) AS total_pay_amt, COUNT(*) AS valid_orders, ROUND(SUM(pay_amt)/COUNT(*),2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01'

cases.question: 2026 年上半年各下单渠道的订单量和总实付金额，渠道 NULL 归「未知渠道」
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(channel,'未知渠道') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2) AS total_pay_amt FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(channel,'未知渠道') ORDER BY total_pay_amt DESC

cases.question: 2026 年 6 月每日 GMV 趋势
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_dt, ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY order_dt ORDER BY order_dt

cases.question: 截至 2026-08-31 每个二级品类的在售商品数量、平均挂牌价、最高挂牌价
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS active_cnt, ROUND(AVG(p.list_price),2) AS avg_list_price, MAX(p.list_price) AS max_list_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND p.launch_dt <= '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY active_cnt DESC

cases.question: 2026 年 618 活动期（6-15 至 6-20）每日支付订单数（按下单日归属）
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_dt, COUNT(CASE WHEN pay_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS paid_orders FROM orders WHERE order_dt >= '2026-06-15' AND order_dt < '2026-06-21' GROUP BY order_dt ORDER BY order_dt

cases.question: 2026 年第二季度有效订单数（涉及订单明细表）
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_dt < '2026-07-01'

cases.question: 2026 年上半年自然期订单的总 GMV（未参与任何促销活动）
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2) AS natural_gmv FROM orders WHERE promo_id IS NULL AND order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01'

cases.question: 大促期间支付时间跨天的订单，仍按下单日统计——每日支付订单数
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_dt, COUNT(*) AS paid_cnt FROM orders WHERE pay_dt IS NOT NULL AND order_dt >= '2026-06-15' AND order_dt < '2026-06-21' GROUP BY order_dt ORDER BY order_dt

cases.question: 2025 年上半年各渠道订单量（历史区间，channel 可能为 NULL）
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(channel,'未知渠道') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND order_dt < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(channel,'未知渠道')

cases.question: 2026 年第二季度「已完成订单」的总实付金额（默认口径：排除取消）
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01'

cases.question: B 级促销对自然期 GMV 的挤压：2026 年有/无 B 活动日的自然期日均 GMV
cases.reference_sql: WITH b_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.dt FROM promo_calendar p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_dt AS dt FROM orders) d ON d.dt BETWEEN p.start_dt AND p.end_dt WHERE p.level = 'B' AND p.start_dt >= '2026-01-01'), daily AS (SELECT order_dt, SUM(pay_amt) AS natural_gmv FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND promo_id IS NULL AND order_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND order_dt < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY order_dt) SELECT CASE WHEN b.dt IS NULL THEN '无B活动日' ELSE '有B活动日' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS days, ROUND(AVG(d.natural_gmv),2) AS avg_natural_gmv FROM daily d LEFT JOIN b_days b ON d.order_dt = b.dt GROUP BY day_type

cases.question: 2026 年第二季度各一级品类的订单 GMV、有效订单量、促销订单占比
cases.reference_sql: WITH cat_map AS (SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_id, category_id) AS lvl1_id FROM categories), base AS (SELECT cm.lvl1_id, o.order_id, o.promo_id, SUM(oi.gmv) AS order_gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN cat_map cm ON p.category_id = cm.category_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_dt < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY cm.lvl1_id, o.order_id, o.promo_id) SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(b.order_gmv),2) AS order_gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT b.order_id) AS valid_orders, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.order_id) * 100, 2) AS promo_order_pct FROM base b JOIN categories c ON b.lvl1_id = c.category_id GROUP BY b.lvl1_id, c.category_name ORDER BY order_gmv DESC

cases.question: 2026 年 6 月与 7 月整体下单转化率对比（支付订单/访客）
cases.reference_sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT CASE WHEN order_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01' THEN '2026-06' ELSE '2026-07' END AS mon, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_cnt FROM orders WHERE pay_dt IS NOT NULL AND ((order_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND order_dt < '2026-07-01') OR (order_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND order_dt < '2026-08-01')) GROUP BY mon), visits AS (SELECT CASE WHEN dt >= '2026-06-01' AND dt < '2026-07-01' THEN '2026-06' ELSE '2026-07' END AS mon, SUM(uv) AS uv FROM traffic WHERE (dt >= '2026-06-01' AND dt < '2026-07-01') OR (dt >= '2026-07-01' AND dt < '2026-08-01') GROUP BY mon) SELECT p.mon AS month, p.paid_cnt AS paid_orders, v.uv AS visitors, ROUND(p.paid_cnt * 100.0 / v.uv, 2) AS conv_rate_pct FROM paid p JOIN visits v ON p.mon = v.mon ORDER BY p.mon
